Junior Software Developer
Harbor Freight Analytics, Sacramento, CA (hybrid, 3 days in office)

About the team
We build dashboards that help regional shippers see where their freight is. Small team, friendly code reviews, lots of mentoring.

You will
- Build features in our React + TypeScript web app
- Write SQL and work with our PostgreSQL database
- Write tests for the code you ship
- Demo your work to customers and teammates

You have
- A bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field
- Experience with React and TypeScript
- Experience with SQL and relational databases
- At least 1 year of professional software development experience (internships count)
- Comfort with Git and code review

Bonus points
- Experience writing automated tests (Jest, Playwright or similar)
- Experience with AWS

Salary range $82,000 to $95,000 plus equity. Health, dental, vision, 401(k). We are an equal opportunity employer.
Apply at harborfreightanalytics.example/careers.
